name: Storm, Earth, and Fire
summary: Prate Cloudseer asks you to help stop the quilboar from flooding Thousand Needles through twisted shamanism. A tome meant for your training may help disperse the coming storm.

sections.title: A Storm Approaches
sections.body: Prate Cloudseer had planned to continue your training, but the threat in Thousand Needles cannot wait. You have seen that the quilboar are not to be taken lightly. Prate gives you a tome meant for study and asks you to gather twisted fire, earth, air, and water totems. The tome may hold a way to disperse the storm they are bringing.

faq.answer: Prate Cloudseer asks you to gather twisted totems in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What are the quilboar trying to do?
faq.answer: Prate says the quilboar mean to flood Thousand Needles through twisted shamanism.
Prate gives you a tome that was meant for study and may help disperse the coming storm.
Prate asks you to gather twisted fire, earth, air, and water totems.

attribution: In-game quest text: Storm, Earth, and Fire
